source: Seams follow CodeHS AP CSA (Cortado) Unit 1 lessons 1.12-1.14 and Unit 3 lessons 3.3-3.9 (objects, anatomy of a class, constructors, methods, this). Structure only: no CodeHS text, problems or code is copied.

lessons.title: Class and instance
lessons.objective: Students will be able to explain the difference between a class and an instance, say what new does, and name the four parts of a class: its name, constructor, parameters and properties.

lessons.title: Properties
lessons.objective: Students will be able to ask a running sketch which class an object came from, read and change a property on one instance, and show that two instances keep separate values.

lessons.title: this and your first constructor
lessons.objective: Students will be able to read this as the variable on the left of the dot, build sprites with both constructor forms, and write a constructor that stores its arguments on this.
